title: Chromium source and Content embedding interfaces
notes: Study selected browser authority, navigation, profile, CDP, Native Messaging, and IPC files; GitHub official source mirror for acquisition. Not a buildable Chromium checkout; DEPS and vendor components remain separate.

title: Chromium Embedded Framework
notes: Acquire full project: docs, headers, libcef, wrapper message router, cefsimple/cefclient and ceftests. Chromium itself is not included.

title: Official CEF embedding sample project
notes: Study sample application, CMake distribution use, subprocess layout; do not fetch binary dependencies or run its build.

title: Official Chrome extension samples
notes: Study activeTab, scripting, side panel, debugger, service-worker and Native Messaging examples; identify legacy Manifest V2 examples before using as evidence.

title: Chrome DevTools Protocol definitions
notes: PDL/JSON schema and protocol version evidence. Chromium runtime capability probes still required; tip-of-tree is not guaranteed backward compatible.

title: Electron embedding and security source
notes: Study WebContentsView, main-process authority, sandbox and IPC policy; no npm install or checkout of Chromium DEPS.

title: Qt WebEngine source and browser samples
notes: Selected source from development branch must not be conflated with released 6.10 APIs. Read profiles, requests, isolated script worlds and native browser samples.

title: Microsoft Edge WebView2 official samples
notes: Study native Win32/WPF shells, WebMessage/host objects, permissions, process lifetime and DevTools methods. Windows-only candidate.

title: WebKit embedding and automation internals
notes: Acquire selected files only: full engine archive is very large. API layout changes by release; record missing selected paths as gaps. GTK/WPE and Cocoa are distinct integration choices.

title: Cog WPE WebKit launcher
notes: Compact WPE shell and platform/backend separation; embedded launcher rather than full desktop browser.

title: Servo embeddable browser engine
notes: Read current Rust and C embedding boundaries, delegate controls and test cases; selective source study, no claim of mainstream-browser parity.

title: Ladybird independent browser
notes: Source for independent engine/browser process architecture and UI separation. Pre-release compatibility/security work is an investigation burden, not a production baseline assumption.

title: Min minimal Electron browser
notes: Full shell for human browsing: tab/task/session structure, permissionManager and browser content/UI ownership. Reference security posture must be evaluated independently.

title: Nyxt programmable browser
notes: Full programmable human-browser shell: command/mode system, buffers, renderer abstraction, WebKit GTK integration and history. Useful interaction/extension design reference.

title: Chromium Content module
notes: Defines content versus chrome, browser platform versus browser-product features, and embedding classes.

title: Chromium multi-process architecture
notes: Architecture introduction; some historical naming/details require checking current source.

title: Chromium site isolation design
notes: SiteInstance, OOPIF, browser-enforced origin/site separation.

title: Chromium Mojo and services
notes: Typed IPC, document-scoped binders, process sandbox, navigation ordering.

title: Chromium Mojo security style guide
notes: Trust compromised renderers; IPC interface validation and lifetime guidance. Official GitHub mirror at acquired Chromium revision; googlesource endpoint returns 503.

title: CEF general usage
notes: Processes, threads, message loops, OSR, request handling and asynchronous JavaScript bridge. Cross-check old passages with current headers.

title: CEF architecture
notes: Modern runtime bootstrap/style split; Alloy bootstrap removal in M128.

title: CEF JavaScript integration
notes: V8 contexts, render-process restrictions and asynchronous integration.

title: CEF sandbox setup
notes: Platform bootstrap requirements, including M138 macOS shared sandbox library and Windows bootstrap change.

title: Chrome native messaging
notes: Allowlisted extension IDs, stdio length-prefixed JSON, message limits and host lifetime.

title: Chrome extension debugger API
notes: Restricted CDP domains, target sessions and debugger detach behavior.

title: Chrome activeTab permission
notes: User gesture scoped temporary access and navigation revocation; useful bounded-delegation precedent.

title: Chrome 136 remote-debugging security changes
notes: Default profile debugging disallowed; custom user-data-dir required for port and pipe.

title: Electron security guidance
notes: Arbitrary remote-content warning, sandbox/context isolation, permissions, sender validation and host API containment.

title: Electron webContents
notes: Navigation and popup hooks, execution, input and lifecycle.

title: Electron WebContentsView
notes: Native view containing webContents; alternative to renderer-owned webview and deprecated BrowserView.

title: Qt WebEngine 6.10 overview
notes: Release-specific overview; unversioned qt-6 URLs redirected to development snapshot during this survey.

title: Qt WebEngine 6.10 profile API
notes: Off-record/persistent storage, permissions and profiles.

title: Qt WebEngine 6.10 page API
notes: Page lifecycle, isolated script worlds, permissions and navigation.

title: WebView2 secure native applications
notes: Origin checks, restricted settings/host objects and navigation-aware script messaging.

title: WebView2 process model
notes: User data folder/process collection and process failures.

title: WebView2 Runtime distribution
notes: Evergreen versus Fixed Version deployment; update responsibility.

title: WebKitGTK WebView API
notes: API 4.1/library 2.42.5 page served at survey time; do not claim newest release. Isolated evaluation, permission and policy hooks.

title: WebKitGTK UserContentManager
notes: Script-message handler registration and world-specific messaging.

title: WPE WebKit overview
notes: Embedded port and backend focus; not equivalent to a complete browser shell.

title: The Servo Book
notes: Follow current embedding chapters from book index; old embedding.html URL did not resolve.

title: Apple WKWebView
notes: macOS/iOS system-WebKit baseline: Cocoa navigation, script bridge and website-data APIs; platform-specific option.
